axis_alternative: target_tokens (a sensitivity: a separate run with this field changed in a separate settings file)
contrast: G_m - G_Rtok,m on the common seeds (report and one-sided bounds only)
name: build_r_tok
requirement: W1-03 (W1 builder extract rev 2), built under addendum section 6.5: R_tok, token-matched random removal for A1, L1 and H1; a secondary arm at 3 seeds (funded tier), one-sided bounds only, never in P1-P6
rule: T_m = the arm's removed mass on the axis; per unit g in ascending group-id order: walk g's members in s1common.sealed_order(members, registry key random_removal.rtok, m, d, g); add rows while the unit's mass stays below T_m / 8; at the row whose mass crosses T_m / 8 keep it only if that brings the unit's mass closer to T_m / 8 (a tie keeps it), then stop; a unit whose whole mass is below T_m / 8 refuses; remove = the sorted union
seed_rule: draw d runs at seed 1100 + d (the secondary-arm seed rule: 1102-1104)
